## About
All Car Auto Painting & Body Repair is a longtime San Mateo body shop on Ninth Avenue. Owner and operator Rod Dowiat and general manager Larry Franquez run a shop built around collision repair and painting for imported and domestic vehicles.
We are a direct repair facility for USAA, Mercury, AAA and Liberty Mutual, and we are pleased to work with all insurance companies. Customers are surveyed by an independent third party so we can keep our work consistent and keep improving.
Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 53 Google reviews, and many of them mention Larry by name for his clear, honest communication.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs from small dings to major collision damage, with the goal of restoring your vehicle to pre-accident condition.
- Auto painting: Paint work for cars and trucks, including panels like tailgates where paint has chipped.
- Insurance claims: We help with repairs done through an insurance claim and are a direct repair facility for USAA, Mercury, AAA and Liberty Mutual.
- Pick up and delivery: Pick up and delivery service to make drop off and pick up easier.
- Written warranty: Our repairs come with a complete written warranty.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We are pleased to work with all insurance companies, and we are a direct repair facility for USAA, Mercury, AAA and Liberty Mutual.

Q: When can I bring my car in for an inspection?
A: You can come in for an inspection anytime during business hours, Monday through Friday.

Q: Do you work on all makes of cars?
A: Yes. We service all imported and domestic vehicles.
